title.zh: 取得的后果修改下一参考构造计划与实际使用
title.en: Acquired consequences revise reference construction and actual use

claim.zh: 在共同 Process/Trace 中，真实活动留下的失配地址修改保留的接触序列；控制器按新序列取得绑定的双参考值，检查分离后安装新记录，后续实际回应随之改变。第二次失配再次修改方法并使用新装置，全程支持不重置。计划、参考、安装和使用各有检查声明；新的已安装接触接回原 Through，旧选择保留直接复用 P93。冻结旧方法、擦除记录、支持不足、常值参考及检查后漂移保留失败。
claim.en: Within the shared Process/Trace, an acquired mismatch address revises a retained contact sequence. The controller executes it, acquires bound reference pairs, checks separation, installs fresh records and changes actual later response. A second mismatch revises the method again without resetting support. Plan, reference, installation and use handoffs are checked; new installed contacts reuse Through and old-choice preservation directly reuses P93. Frozen methods, erased receipts, insufficient support, constant references and post-check drift retain failures.

hypotheses.zh: 给定可寻址的二值接触原语、目标及普通任务顺序、可靠实际回返、两参考的地址绑定及检查到使用间的稳定对应。
hypotheses.en: Supplied addressed Boolean contacts, targets and ordinary undertaking order, faithful actual return, bound reference pairs and stable correspondence between checking and use.

hypotheses.zh: 修订律把取得的失败地址接入旧接触序列开头；检查律要求每对参考分离，装配及留存可执行。原语与修订／检查律的自身取得没有被假定已解释。
hypotheses.en: The revision rule prepends an acquired failed address to the retained sequence; checking requires each reference pair to separate, with operative assembly and retention. Formation of those primitives and revision/check rules is not claimed explained.

hypotheses.zh: 局部支持账给每次普通操作1、双参考接触2的消耗；执行须足额，见证从30开始，无补给。不是通用物理成本或分子材料账。
hypotheses.en: The local support account charges one per ordinary operation and two per reference pair, with affordability required. The witness starts with 30 and has no replenishment; these are not universal physical costs or molecular stocks.

hypotheses.zh: 新增候选相对于当前接触计划及装置；可用原语和地址空间仍属于给定总律。登记等价针对装置已安装的接触域，实际编码与使用另行检查。 普通活动回返属于整体的另一实际关系；不把已安装参考域当作系统全部接触。漂移是同一过程内给定且有消耗的原语。
hypotheses.en: Candidate novelty is relative to the current contact plan and apparatus; primitives and address space remain in the supplied encompassing law. Registration concerns installed contacts, with actual encoding and use checked separately. Ordinary return is another actual relationship within the whole; installed reference registration is not total system access. Drift is an admitted, charged primitive of the same process.

correspondence.zh: 活动、回返、方法、装置、支持和回应是同一关系展开内的分化作用。P99 是共享主干的新实例；既有查询选择、方法形成、校准和传递成果被信用，不冒充所有旧化学／网络模型的同历史形式拼接。固定总律不取消内部方法修改，也不消除其科学前提。
correspondence.en: Activity, return, method, apparatus, support and response are differentiated roles within one unfolding. P99 is a new shared-spine instance. Existing inquiry, method-formation, calibration and transmission results are credited, not claimed formally concatenated across all older chemical/network models. A fixed encompassing law does not erase internal method change or discharge scientific premises.

detail.en: Earlier procedure reconstruction and successor use are complete; this adds revision of the next reference-contact plan, without a new adapter across the older material model.

detail.zh: 本实例的实际操作成为下一反复修订结果的输入。
detail.en: This instance’s actual operations feed the recurring-revision result.

detail.zh: frozen_second_method_still_fails 保留第一修复及更多支持，却不能处理第二失配；erased_receipt_cannot_activate、support_too_small_to_build、constant_channel_rejected 与 drift_after_check_can_fail 保留回执、支持、可分性及稳定范围的失败。 drift_has_actual_history 给出检查后的漂移和失败的同一 Trace，不只替换对照起始配置。
detail.en: frozen_second_method_still_fails retains the first repair and more support yet misses the second mismatch; erased_receipt_cannot_activate, support_too_small_to_build, constant_channel_rejected and drift_after_check_can_fail preserve failures of receipt, support, separation and stability. drift_has_actual_history gives a shared Trace for post-check drift and failure, rather than only changing the control’s starting configuration.

limitations.zh: 完成有条件的局部方法—参考—装置—使用接口，未推导任意新感知原语、修订编译器的自身取得、所有普通任务的自主选择、真实接触可靠性、通用吸引／盆地、规范正当性或无实质前提基础。有限见证不是普遍可纠正性；旧材料模型的正式组合仍未新增。
limitations.en: Completes a conditional local method–reference–apparatus–use interface, without deriving arbitrary sensing primitives, acquisition of the revision compiler, autonomous selection of all ordinary tasks, actual contact reliability, general attraction/basins, normative warrant or a premise-free foundation. The finite witness is not universal corrigibility; no new formal composition of older material models is claimed.
